annotations.title: Create a transparent video from a plan

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Spends credits. Consumes a plan from plan_transparent_video and starts the render with exactly the request the builder sends. Calling it again with the same planId is safe -- it returns the same render instead of creating a second one. Returns renderId, projectId and the builder link immediately; call get_render_status for progress. Like the builder, a first video that matches an earlier finished one exactly is reused at no charge (reused: true).
name: create_transparent_video
title: Create a transparent video from a plan
